items.text: In October, World Series games were broadcast on television for the first time, and the New York Yankees beat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3.
items.question: How did you follow the Yankees and Dodgers World Series that fall, and did you see any of it on television?
items.source_quote: October 6 – World Series games are broadcast on television for the first time. The New York Yankees defeat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3, to win their 11th World Series Title.

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: On April 15, Jackie Robinson became the first African American to play Major League Baseball since the 1880s.
items.question: Who in your family talked about Jackie Robinson playing in the major leagues, and where were you living then?
items.source_quote: April 15 – Jackie Robinson becomes the first African American to play Major League Baseball since the 1880s.

items.text: On October 14, Air Force test pilot Captain Chuck Yeager flew the Bell X-1 rocket plane faster than the speed of sound.
items.question: Do you remember hearing that a plane had flown faster than the speed of sound, and who told you about it?
items.source_quote: October 14 – The United States Air Force test pilot Captain Chuck Yeager flies a Bell X-1 rocket plane faster than the speed of sound
